ideal: Note the LLY drop vs the index with 'no filing explains it yet' on that line, then a separate line for the same-day Schedule 13D with a plain-words description and link.

verdicts.note: Accurate, clean two lines, but omits the required 'no filing explains it yet' and stacking the 13D under the drop invites her to guess it's the reason.
verdicts.answer:
Eli Lilly fell 3.76% (S&P 500 rose 0.27%)  
Eli Lilly filed a Schedule 13D (beneficial‑ownership report) https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/59478/000119312526013469/xslSCHEDULE_13D_X01/primary_doc.xml

verdicts.note: Best handling of a tricky case: price line vs index ends with 'no filing explains it yet', and the 13D is reported separately with a plain-words description of what it is, not implied as the cause.
verdicts.answer:
Eli Lilly (LLY), Jan 15: fell 3.76% while the S&P 500 rose 0.27% — no filing explains it yet.
Eli Lilly filing, Jan 15: a Schedule 13D, the disclosure someone files when they own more than 5% of a company — https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/59478/000119312526013469/xslSCHEDULE_13D_X01/primary_doc.xml

verdicts.note: Numbers all check out (4.03 gap is in the report), but 'lodged the same day' ties the 13D to the drop without evidence, and the mandated no-explanation clause is missing.
verdicts.answer: Eli Lilly fell 3.76% (S&P 500 up 0.27%) — an underperformance of 4.03 pts. An SCHEDULE 13D filing was lodged the same day (change in beneficial ownership), link: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/59478/000119312526013469/xslSCHEDULE_13D_X01/primary_doc.xml.

verdicts.note: Has the required clause but jammed against the filing link it reads as a contradiction; never says what a Schedule 13D is, and the run-on line is confusing.
verdicts.answer: Eli Lilly fell 3.76% while S&P 500 rose 0.27%; SCHEDULE 13D filing https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/59478/000119312526013469/xslSCHEDULE_13D_X01/primary_doc.xml no filing explains it yet
